description: This file contains shell functions for comparing and sanitizing diff outputs, used in a testing context. It includes functions to compare raw diffs, handle specific diff formats, and ignore non-essential differences like heuristics scores and indices.

methods.name: compare_diff_raw
methods.description: Compares two diff files after sanitizing out heuristic-specific data such as object IDs and status indicators.

methods.name: compare_diff_raw_z
methods.description: Compares two diff files with additional handling for null bytes and a different sanitization pattern.

methods.name: compare_diff_patch
methods.description: Compares two diff patches while ignoring non-essential lines like index lines and similarity scores.
